verdict: Meta delivering 97 leads efficiently; overdue buildout remains the priority.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 97 leads from Meta at a cost of $11.50 per lead — a rate that has held nearly flat through this week's slight volume dip, which tracks with normal budget pacing rather than a performance shift. The bigger picture is that several planned components of your full program — including CRM setup, search campaigns, and landing pages — are significantly overdue, meaning Meta is currently carrying all of the work without the supporting stack beneath it. Closing those gaps is the active focus right now. Separately, website session tracking dropped sharply on October 19th; that is being investigated and does not reflect a change in your ad performance. Once the buildout milestones are resolved, you should see leads flowing into confirmed pipeline and additional channels coming online.
